prompts.square:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Android launcher icon for the game Escape from 1829, a single square opaque image, ideally 1024x1024.
Primary request: a head-on shot of the front of Cheshire County Asylum, with the blue dragons, steps and entrance door clearly visible.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual frontal entrance photograph and is the architectural reference; Image 2 is the game's existing untitled square promotional artwork and is the style and colour reference. Create a new icon composition, not a screenshot or mockup.
Subject: symmetrical THREE-storey red-brick central frontage above its stone basement. Large white-edged triangular pediment with TWO vivid BLUE heraldic dragons, curled tails and a gold-and-blue central coat of arms. These are painted architectural reliefs within the pediment. Three white sash windows in each of the upper two rows; lower central red panelled door with paired pale columns and flanking sash windows. Dark railing at the raised doorway landing. Front stone approach steps rise to a middle landing and branch symmetrically to the raised doorway behind its railing.
Composition: precisely centred, straight-on elevation with no oblique angle. Fit the ENTIRE central pediment, both dragons, entrance columns, red door and complete steps inside the middle 66% of the canvas width and middle 66% of its height, with pediment apex near y=19% and bottom of steps near y=82%. The central frontage is the dominant readable subject. Side wings continue softly towards canvas edges. Simplify fine detail so the architecture and blue dragons remain recognisable at tiny launcher sizes. Do not crop the pediment or steps. Keep critical features away from the corners for circular and rounded-square Android masks.
Style: polished atmospheric illustrated game art, closely matching Image 2, slightly simplified for a small app icon, crisp architectural silhouette and clear pale trim. Dark muted green twilight sky, warm red brick, ivory trim, saturated cobalt-blue relief, subtle warm windows and doorway light. Clear exposure and restrained shadows; little or no fog on the steps.
Constraints: one square edge-to-edge image, opaque background, no pre-rounded corners, no border, no text, no title, no letters or numbers, no logo, no watermark, no people, no cars, no added monsters or towers, no flying dragons, no foreground trees or lanterns blocking any entrance feature. No collage or device mockup.
prompts.adaptive:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Android adaptive launcher icon background, square opaque image.
Edit target: the supplied new asylum entrance artwork.
Change only composition and camera distance for Android adaptive-icon safety. Keep the same building, head-on symmetry, THREE storeys, blue dragons and central coat of arms in the triangular pediment, red door, columns, railings, complete steps, colour palette, illustrated style and lighting. The entire central facade from apex to bottom step must now fit between y=24% and y=75% of the FULL square canvas, and its full pediment width must fit between x=28% and x=72%. This is critical: render the building significantly SMALLER than the supplied image, as if the camera has moved much farther backwards. Plenty of natural sky ABOVE and empty approach BELOW are required. The outer thirds are bleed that Android will crop; every defining entrance feature must be safely inside the CENTRAL HALF of the complete canvas. Continue the existing sky, side wings and approach naturally to all four edges. Do not add a frame or an inset card; this is one continuous scene. Retain clear saturated blue dragons, ivory trim, red-brick facade, red doorway and stone steps. No text, no logos, no watermark, no people, no added objects, no rounded corners. Exactly one square opaque full-bleed image.

note: AI-generated illustrated entrance artwork. Adaptive background has extra sky/approach bleed to preserve the blue dragons, doorway and steps under launcher masks. Unity creates a clear foreground layer for the static illustrated scene.
